description: Retrieval evaluation set for the fixture books. A hit is correct when it comes from expectedFile and its text contains any of expectedContains (case-insensitive). Types: answerable (shares words with the passage), paraphrase (shares almost none), cross-language (question and book are in different languages), keyword (a name), out-of-library (expectedFile is null; the library should say it doesn't cover the topic).
